text:
alejandra: customer reported SSE stream 'ghosts' during commute — they see partial JSON payload then the socket closes. app: ReactNative 1.8.2 (okhttp 4.9), SDK: web-sse 0.9.7. Billing question: they were charged for partial response.

mike: can you paste client logs and the server last-event-id if they saw one? also which region and model?

alejandra: attaching what customer sent: 
```
Client log: E/okhttp: stream failed due to connection closed
ERR: net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED
last_event_id: 4382
request headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Connection: keep-alive, Accept: text/event-stream
```
Region: eu-west-1, model: gpt-open-3.2.

jon: ticket created S-1829, linked to acct 00123. ingested initial logs. :white_check_mark:

luis-qa: quick hypothesis — mobile network switch causes client TCP to close; okhttp does automatic reconnect but SSE client often gives up because the response stream ended with incomplete chunk. Need repro steps and whether token refresh was attempted mid-stream.

alejandra: customer says token refresh was attempted 1s after dropout but app threw before refresh handler could run. They also reported ephemeral-ttl=60s in the token payload.

mike: that TTL is short for long answers + roaming. If token rotates, and client attempts refresh while socket is midstream, some SDKs close the socket and don't resume. Two actionable items: 1) reproduce with TTL=300 and 2) enable server heartbeat (comment lines) so client sees traffic and doesn't hit perceived idle.

luis-qa: repro plan I put in the ticket: 
1) Start stream with long response (>40s).
2) On device, toggle wifi off -> force switch to cellular after ~12s.
3) Observe client logs for ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED and server logs for connection termination.
4) Try with refreshed token TTL=300 and again with our keepalive comment enabled.

jon: server log snippet (from proxy): 
```
[2026-02-12T14:22:41Z] conn=xy123 closed by client: EOF
[2026-02-12T14:22:41Z] last_event_id=4382
[2026-02-12T14:22:41Z] bytes_sent=12.4KB
[2026-02-12T14:22:41Z] client_ip=10.4.5.6 (mobile)
```
Not seeing an explicit 4xx/5xx, just EOF.

mike: that matches network flip. For customer-facing remediation: recommend increasing token TTL OR using short-lived refresh pattern that can reopen/resume the stream. Also suggest adding comment heartbeats so the app's socket isn't considered idle by OS/proxy. Example server-side keepalive for SSE: 
```
setInterval(() => {
  res.write(': keepalive\n\n');
}, 15000);
```
This sends SSE comments every 15s and keeps intermediate proxies from closing.

alejandra: passing that to customer. also advising client change: in okhttp, set readTimeout(0) for indefinite read (or high value) and implement `onFailure` handler to retry with `Last-Event-ID` header when reconnecting. sample client pseudo: 
```
// on reconnect
if (lastEventId) fetch(`/v1/stream?last_event_id=${lastEventId}`)
```

luis-qa: small note — Last-Event-ID behavior depends on model/state. For Redwood streams we persist prefix cache per request id; rehydration currently works if the client resends the original request and includes the last_event_id; QA will verify semantics.

jon: also flagged possible billing follow-up — partial downstream tokens were billed. ops: can we confirm how billing records partial-stream charges and whether we can offer credit? ingests: @ingest-bot any way to mark S-1829 for billing review?

ingest-bot: billing flag added to S-1829, forwarded to billing-team.

mike: final triage checklist for engineering: 
- [ ] Verify server sends comment heartbeats by default for hosted API (or document how to enable).
- [ ] Confirm proxy timeouts (nginx/ALB) and make recommendation for customers (e.g., idle timeout >60s).
- [ ] Add guidance in SDK docs about token TTL and reconnect with Last-Event-ID.
- [ ] QA reproducer and attach deterministic logs.

alejandra: customer wants ETA on workaround. I'll provide the keepalive snippet + client readTimeout suggestion and tell them QA is attempting repro. updating ticket S-1829. :memo: 

mike: thanks — if QA confirms repro, we'll prioritize a docs patch and an ops note.

jon: thanks all. leaving channel for now, will post updates in S-1829.
